description: Represents a node in the column dimension tree of a pivot table result.

members.name: Children
members.description: Child nodes for multi-level column dimensions.

members.name: ColIndex
members.description: The column index in the rendered table (computed after flattening).

members.name: ColSpan
members.description: The number of leaf columns this node spans (for colspan).

members.name: DisplayValue
members.description: The display text for this column node.

members.name: Key
members.description: The raw key value for this column node.

members.name: Level
members.description: Zero-based depth level in the column tree.

members.name: Totals
members.description: Column total values keyed by value field index.
